# Santhidam Bethania Matriculation School
> Co-educational, private unaided Tamil Nadu State Board school in Kanyakumari, est. 2003, serving KG to Secondary.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://www.santhidambethaniaschool.com/index.html): Overview, admissions, campus highlights
- [About](https://www.santhidambethaniaschool.com/about.html): History, milestones, awards, management committee
- [Academics](https://www.santhidambethaniaschool.com/academics.html): KG-Secondary curriculum, subjects, assessment
- [Admissions](https://www.santhidambethaniaschool.com/admissions.html): Steps, eligibility, fees, dates, FAQs
- [Facilities](https://www.santhidambethaniaschool.com/facilities.html): Labs, library, sports, safety
- [Gallery](https://www.santhidambethaniaschool.com/gallery.html): Events, sports, academics, culture
- [Contact](https://www.santhidambethaniaschool.com/contact.html): Address, phone, email

## Key facts
- Established 2003
- Tamil Nadu State Board, co-educational, private unaided
- Location: Kottakarai Road, Kanyakumari District, Tamil Nadu
